requirements.description: Full historical 1998 PCEC must be registered with exact edition, 258-page structural inventory and source custody status
Versioned PCEC chart release requires source-specific authority chain and institution CFO/compliance approval
Every account mapping must be effective-dated and uniquely applicable by institution and profile
Off-balance class-9 postings must satisfy independent double-entry balancing invariants
Derived management class-8 indicators must not post money or alter ledger balances
Closed accounting periods reject ordinary backdated postings; exceptional complementary window requires approval
Historical corrections use explicit journal reversal/reposting, never edits to posted journals
Reports must reconstruct from source to journal to mapped report cell in both directions
Credit classification/provision calculations cannot directly mutate GL or bypass posting authorization
Historical 1998 Cameroon fiscal-year statement must never be promoted into current operational configuration without 2026 authority
R-2018/01 Article 33 legal-effect discrepancy must be legally resolved before historical applicability rules activate
Unverified chart code or ambiguous amendment chain must fail closed; no silent generic OHADA/public-sector substitution

scenarios.description: Given 1998 chart and no current amendments approval, activating its codes fails
Overlapping effective-dated ACTIVE chart releases are rejected
Unbalanced class-9 off-balance journal is rejected
Attempted class-8 money-creating posting is rejected
Posting ordinary journal into SEALED period fails
Complementary-day attempt without dual approval fails
Editing posted historical journal fails; correction requires new linked reversal
Changing historical mapping after posting leaves historical reports reproducible
Missing residence/group attribute generates evidence exception, not fabricated value
Credit risk classification event cannot change ledger balance directly
Missing R-2018/01 Article 33 legal interpretation blocks retroactive rule activation
Generic SYSCOHADA/public-sector account mapping rejected for banking PCEC without explicit authority
Unknown source account code routes to controlled exception without auto-posting
Repeated outbox delivery and retries do not duplicate postings
Unknown settlement outcome remains unresolved and no finality or liquidity is fabricated
As-filed and restated reports both preserve evidence and reconciliation
